title: Unicorn and Crescent Moon
description: A white unicorn wearing a crown stands beside a large stylized blue tree holding a crescent moon staff. Three reflective blue metallic spheres rest in rippling blue water in the foreground, with a giant black and white crescent moon behind the tree under a purple cloudy sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene featuring a white unicorn with a crown standing on a reflective blue surface, holding a golden staff with a crescent moon. A large stylized swirling blue tree grows behind it. Three shiny metallic blue spheres of different sizes sit in rippling water creating concentric circles. A massive black crescent moon with white outline dominates the background. Purple sky with soft clouds and sparkling particles, dreamy ethereal atmosphere.
